thread:
Alex: Quick sync — FinSys requested a BYO-CMK POC with HSM compatibility, rotation proof, and an internal pen-test before go-live. Tight timeline: 2 weeks. What are blockers?

Maria (SE): Noted. Primary blockers: exact HSM model/firmware, whether they want on-prem connector vs our in-cloud CloudHSM, network peering/VPC details, and whether BYO-HSM is acceptable for Dedicated or must be Private deployment. Also need throughput numbers to size Dedicated.

Sean (Crypto-Ops): We support BYO-CMK via our key-wrap handshake. Clarify: do they require key escrow / split custody? threshold signing? Also want to know rotation mode — automated scheduled rotation or manual ceremonies?

Jess (FinSys): Hi — they want automated rotations on 30/60/90-day cadence plus ability for emergency manual rotation. Key escrow is optional (would help recovery). Requirements: FIPS 140-2 validated HSM, SOC2 evidence, and pen-test before week 2 deploy.

Maria (SE): For FIPS HSMs we support standard CloudHSM and Thales/Luna variants on Dedicated and Private. For BYO, we need PKCS#11 interface and client connectivity. We don’t support custom firmware images being installed by us. Can you get model and firmware rev?

Alex: @Jess can you confirm whether they expect us to host the HSM connector (on-prem agent) or connect to their on-prem HSM via a tunnel? Also need approximate QPS and token/unwrap counts.

Jess (FinSys): They'll share the HSM model later today. Traffic: ~150 concurrent inference requests/sec, ~10k KMS unwraps/day. Latency SLO: <100ms p50 for auth flows.

Sean (Crypto-Ops): That workload is fine. Note: unwrap adds ~5-15ms depending on HSM and network. For high QPS recommend caching wrapped CMKs in the runtime (we do KV cache) to avoid repeated unwraps on each request. Also recommend pinning warmed model containers to reduce cold starts.

Maria (SE): For demo we’ll include a rotation runbook and sample logs. Runbook snippet:

```
# rotate CMK
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/rotate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key_id":"cmk-abc123","mode":"automatic"}'
```

We’ll show emergency manual rotate flow as well.

Linda (Legal): We need an SOW addendum that defines responsibilities for BYO-HSM firmware, key custody, and any escrow. Also list liabilities during key ceremony and pen-test scope. Let Finance know if rotation windows will trigger additional billable support.

Nina (Finance): Quote guidance: BYO-HSM POC = $3,000 flat setup fee + hourly crypto-ops beyond 8 hours. Dedicated capacity to meet latency SLOs priced separately. I can draft PS addendum with estimates.

Alex: Action items: 1) @Jess provide HSM model + firmware 2) @Sean produce POC runbook + rotation logs 3) @Maria draft network/peering checklist and deployment mode options 4) @Linda and @Nina draft SOW addendum and fees. Follow-up in 48h. :thumbsup: 

Security-Bot: Security questionnaire submitted to FinSys — ETA 72h.

Jess (FinSys): One more: do you support cross-region key replication for DR?

Sean (Crypto-Ops): Yes, we can do wrapped-key export and replication over our secure vault replication channel if customer permits. Need to validate export controls and include replication steps in runbook.

Alex: Good. I'll schedule a 30-min POC kickoff tomorrow morning. If pen-test must run earlier, ping me and we’ll reprioritize.
